caption: The drawing features a single dress as the main object, centered on a beige background. The dress has long, puffed sleeves and a high neckline with a small v-shaped opening. The color of the dress is a muted brownish-pink or tan shade, with visible cross-hatch lines indicating fabric texture. Decorative elements include a band of floral embroidery with green leaves and pink flowers along the neckline and at the lower edge of the skirt. A matching belt or band is drawn at the waist, and the cuffs are plain. To the right of the main dress, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of the same dress, showing less detail and without color or embroidery, indicating a back or alternate view. The overall composition leaves a large amount of empty space around the dress, focusing attention on the garment and its details.
title: Child's Dress
